searchText: Hi! Recently I have created a PR (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3773). Can any available editors review it please? Any suggestions on how to get notified/see when EIP PRs are merged for new draft EIPs? <@642887713246150666> ☝️ Related to your newsletter I think. This should provide a monthly update of EIPs moving to different statuses - https://hackmd.io/@poojaranjan/EthereumImprovementProposalsInsight/https%3A%2F%2Fhackmd.io%2F%40poojaranjan%2FEIPsInsightAugust2021 The fastest way to get notified is to subscribe to https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pulls but then you'll get notification of all PRs. Thanks, that isn't going to meet my needs as I need it weekly, I will keep checking PRs manually
